map.水料比突然升高可能预示热应激、饲料含盐量过高或疾病（如发热、腹泻）；突然降低可能: A sudden rise may signal heat stress, excess salt or disease (fever, diarrhea); a sudden drop may signal water-system failure, water quality or appetite loss. Record daily.
map.由饮水量与采食量求水料比。: From water and feed intake compute the ratio.

map.水料比=2:1；温升 5℃ 修正系数 1+0.03×5=1.15，推荐下限上浮约: Ratio=2:1; 5°C rise correction 1+0.03×5=1.15, recommended lower bound up ~15%.
map.35℃ 时系数 1.45，水料比需求显著升高。: At 35°C the factor 1.45; ratio demand rises sharply.
map.猪约 2~3:1、禽约 1.8~2.5:1（按干料），随温变。: Pig ~2–3:1, poultry ~1.8–2.5:1 (by dry feed), varying with temperature.
map.每升 1℃ 需水量约增 3%~6%，高温须保证供水。: Each 1°C rise adds about 3%–6% water demand; ensure supply in heat.
